question: The obstetric conjugate (the true AP diameter of the pelvic inlet) is obtained by subtracting 1.5 cm from the diagonal conjugate measured on clinical pelvimetry.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Review the pelvimetry formula. Obstetric conjugate = Diagonal conjugate − 1.5 cm. The obstetric conjugate is the shortest AP diameter of the inlet and the one of greatest clinical relevance for delivery planning.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The standard formula is: Obstetric conjugate = Diagonal conjugate − 1.5 cm. A diagonal conjugate <11.5 cm suggests an obstetric conjugate <10 cm, indicating a contracted inlet.
